name: issue-533-follow-link-switch
description: Spec follow-link-switch: gF labels the two links of fixture:article.html, and the status bar names both outcomes beside the HINT badge, 'a background · A go there' (follow-link-switch-hints). Typing the first label's last character in upper case, A, opens the long page in a new tab after the article and selects it. The status bar shows the fixture server's port, a few digits that vary between runs, well inside the 0.5 % screenshot tolerance.
